description: This file defines the class `EmailTemplateFormBase`, which provides methods for rendering forms, handling save operations, processing attachments, and managing email template data within a SuiteCRM module. It serves as a base form class for email template management, including HTML form generation, attachment handling, and access control.

classes.name: EmailTemplateFormBase
classes.description: A base class providing functionalities to create, display, and process email template forms, including handling attachments and access permissions within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for initializing the form class.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Generates the HTML form body for email template input, including subject and description fields, with JavaScript validation.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Produces the complete HTML form for creating or editing an email template, including headers, footers, and save button.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles the process of saving the email template data, including attachment processing and text-only flags.

methods.name: handleAttachmentsProcessImages
methods.description: Processes embedded images in the email template body, replacing them with secure links and saving image files.

methods.name: processImages
methods.description: Extracts images from the email body HTML, copies files, and updates the content with secure URLs.

methods.name: handleAttachments
methods.description: Manages uploading, associating, duplicating, and removing file attachments related to the email template.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Verifies current user permissions for saving or modifying email templates, enforcing access control.
